description: This file defines functions and constants for fetching and managing Gemini models via the GoogleGenAI API, including model normalization, support checks, and static model fallback.

methods.name: normalizeModelId
methods.description: Extracts the canonical model identifier from the API model resource name.

methods.name: isSupportedModelId
methods.description: Checks if a model ID starts with supported prefixes.

methods.name: createModelInfo
methods.description: Creates a ModelInfo object with provided parameters, applying defaults and static info.

methods.name: getGeminiModels
methods.description: Fetches Gemini models from API or returns static models if API key is missing or on error.
